data.answer: Production access is just-in-time and lasts a maximum of 8 hours before expiring automatically. Interns are not eligible for production access.
The provided knowledge chunks do not contain information on whether background checks are performed on sub-processors' staff.

After a contract ends, customer data stays available for export for 90 days. Once that window closes, the data is deleted from production systems within 30 days, and backups expire on their normal 35-day cycle so the last copy is gone no later than 35 days after production deletion.

Nimbus Labs completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering the Nimbus Ledger Sync platform for the audit period from 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026, issued on 14 August 2026 by Harlow & Pike LLP, with the next audit period beginning 1 July 2026 for 12 months.
The provided knowledge chunks do not state the cyber insurance provider, policy number, or coverage limit.

Customer data is stored in India by default at AWS Mumbai, with disaster recovery copies held in Singapore. For transaction data processed for banks, Nimbus Labs acts as a data processor on the customer's instructions, while the customer remains the data fiduciary.

Customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) are not supported in the current product and all keys are managed by Nimbus Labs through AWS KMS, with this capability not on the committed roadmap. The report covers the production platform hosted on AWS in Mumbai primary and Singapore disaster recovery, and does not cover customer-operated systems.
The provided knowledge chunks do not state whether source code will be placed in escrow for Meridian Bank.

The provided knowledge chunks do not contain CVs of engineers working on the Meridian project, though a 24x7 on-call rotation covers P1 and P2 incidents with four engineers, each on call for one week at a time.
Nimbus Labs holds a SOC 2 Type II report and does not yet hold ISO 27001 certification, which is planned for 2027.
